description: The file defines the MBModule class, which manages module creation, configuration, layout, localization, and other functionalities within the SuiteCRM Module Builder environment. It includes methods for creating, copying, renaming, deleting modules, handling metadata, templates, relationships, fields, and assets like icons.

classes.name: MBModule
classes.description: A class managing SuiteCRM module lifecycle, configuration, fields, layouts, localization, and assets within the Module Builder interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new MBModule object with given parameters and loads configuration and dependencies.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates module files and directories in the specified base path.

methods.name: createClasses
methods.description: Generates PHP class and vardefs files for the module based on current configuration.

methods.name: createMenu
methods.description: Generates the module menu PHP file.

methods.name: addTemplate
methods.description: Adds a new template type to the module configuration.

methods.name: removeTemplate
methods.description: Removes a template type from the module configuration.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames the module directory and updates metadata accordingly.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the module with a new name.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the module directory and all associated files.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current module configuration and related data.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Writes the module's configuration array to a PHP file.

methods.name: setConfigMD5
methods.description: Calculates and sets an MD5 hash of the current configuration.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads module configuration and related language and vardef data.

methods.name: addField
methods.description: Adds a new field definition to the module.

methods.name: deleteField
methods.description: Removes a field definition by name.

methods.name: fieldExists
methods.description: Checks if a field with specified name and/or type exists.

methods.name: getVardefs
methods.description: Retrieves the current vardef array for the module.

methods.name: getModuleName
methods.description: Returns the name of the module.

methods.name: getPackageName
methods.description: Returns the package name associated with the module.
